hooks.command:
bash -c 'LOG="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/acd/codex-hook.log"; LOG_DIR="$(dirname "$LOG")"; [ -d "$LOG_DIR" ] || mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true; OUT=$(acd hook-stdin-extract session_id cwd? <&0 2>>"$LOG") || { printf '"'"'[%s] active hook failed exit=%d cmd=acd-hook-stdin-extract
'"'"' "$(date +%FT%T%z)" "$?" >>"$LOG"; exit 0; }; SID=$(printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' "$OUT" | sed -n 1p); CWD=$(printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' "$OUT" | sed -n 2p); REPO="${CWD:-$PWD}"; acd start --session-id "$SID" --harness codex --watch-pid "$PPID" --repo "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG" || { printf '"'"'[%s] active hook failed exit=%d cmd=acd-start
'"'"' "$(date +%FT%T%z)" "$?" >>"$LOG"; exit 1; }'
